title: Seoul Studio
subtitle: Me, my family & friends
grammar: to be: I'm / you're / he's / she's / it's
to be: questions & short answers (Are you…? Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Is he…? Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.)
possessive adjectives: my, your, his, her
have got / has got (I've got…, She's got…, Have you got…? Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.)
questions: What's your name? How old are you? Where are you from?

story.title: Hana's First Day
paragraphs: This is Hana. She's eleven. She's from Seoul. Today is her first day at Star Academy.
Coach Mina says, "Hello! What's your name?" "My name is Hana," she says. "How old are you?" "I'm eleven."
There are twenty trainees. Hana is number nineteen. She is happy!

paragraphs: Hello! I'm Max. I'm a boy. I'm twelve. I'm a trainee at Star Academy.
My friend is Leo. He's ten. We count, "One, two, three, four!" and we dance.
